problems.what: goal, go, resume, cancel and their slash variants perform no operation and still exit 0. Against a host that logs its requests, each produced exactly one GET /healthz and nothing else; the positional session id, run id and goal text are never read (cliNeedsHost receives args and discards them). The record's own status is 'HOST_ANSWERED' with a capability string explaining that the work belongs to the host, but the exit code is 0 and the card's file states the opposite rule for exactly this situation: 'A command that cannot do its real work says so with 3 and a machine-readable reason; it never prints a plausible-looking success' (apps/cli/cli_contract.go:10-11). This is the card's named negative 空stub, and W0503-LIVE-HOST-ANSWERED plus W0503-RESUME-GOES-THROUGH-THE-HOST assert the stub behaviour as the expected result.
problems.would_resolve_it: Either drive the declared local_operations (a POST/GET that carries the session/run id) and assert the host's reply, or answer these verbs with exit 3 and a named NOT_BOUND reason and change the two rows that currently require exit 0. Whichever is chosen, the receipt's action-2 line must stop listing those verbs as exit-code-verified successes.

That is the card's named negative 静默模型切换.
problems.would_resolve_it: Add a row that calls config set-model with --config-revision and --settled but no recorded settled run and requires a refusal naming the missing settled run, then re-run the matrix.

problems.what: the deliverable 'every command has a handler, help and a check' is produced from a hand-written table rather than measured. No file under tests/, apps/ or bootstrap/ references doctor at all, so nothing in the repository measures the command product.contract marks required.
measured_by: grep for doctor across tests/ apps/ bootstrap/

A table entry whose handler is not exercised cannot support the deliverable.

problems.what: receipt wording is ahead of measurement in four places that this review measured directly: (a) the negative-case table states 'a model switch happens silently -> CAUGHT ... the settled-run confirmation is a separate row' (contradicted by R04); (b) the deliverable-2 evidence names mutation N08 as covering 'the install is an empty stub or an alias to another vendor CLI', while N08 only mutates the shim text and the delegation guard is file-scoped (R07); (c) falsifiability.round1 counts crashed-mutant-ill-formed: 0 while its own disclosed finding says M09 made the package stop compiling; (d) commands[0].note and assertions.identical_across_three_runs are true, but the surrounding text presents the 46 ids as establishing the card's coverage, which R02/R03 show they do not.
